title: Blind and lantern
simplified_paragraphs: 在还没有灯的时候，人们晚上都会点灯笼照路。
有一天，一个盲人到朋友家做客，天黑后，他的朋友为他点了个灯笼，说：“天晚了，路黑，你打个灯笼回家吧!”
盲人很生气地说：“你知道我看不见，还让我打个灯笼照路，不是笑话我吗?”
他的朋友说：“你错了。你在路上走，别人也在路上走，你打着灯笼，别人就可以看到你，就不会撞到你了。
traditional_paragraphs: 在還沒有燈的時候，人們晚上都會點燈籠照路。
有一天，一個盲人到朋友家做客，天黑後，他的朋友為他點了個燈籠，說：“天晚了，路黑，你打個燈籠回家吧!”
盲人很生氣地說：“你知道我看不見，還讓我打個燈籠照路，不是笑話我嗎?”
他的朋友說：“你錯了。你在路上走，別人也在路上走，你打著燈籠，別人就可以看到你，就不會撞到你了。
pinyin_paragraphs: zài hái méi yǒu dēng de shí hou， rén men wǎn shang dōu huì diǎn dēng long zhào lù。
yǒu yī tiān， yī gè máng rén dào péng you jiā zuò kè， tiān hēi hòu， tā de péng you wèi tā diǎn le gè dēng long， shuō：“ tiān wǎn le， lù hēi， nǐ dǎ gè dēng long huí jiā ba !”
máng rén hěn shēng qì de shuō：“ nǐ zhī dào wǒ kàn bù jiàn， hái ràng wǒ dǎ gè dēng long zhào lù， bù shì xiào hua wǒ ma ?”
tā de péng you shuō：“ nǐ cuò le。 nǐ zài lù shang zǒu， bié rén yě zài lù shang zǒu， nǐ dǎ zhe dēng long， bié rén jiù kě yǐ kàn dào nǐ， jiù bù huì zhuàng dào nǐ le。
english_paragraphs: Before electric lights existed, people used lanterns to light their way at night.
One day, a blind man visited a friend. After dark, his friend lit a lantern for him and said, “It’s late and the road is dark. Take this lantern home with you!”
The blind man said angrily, “You know I can’t see, yet you’re telling me to carry a lantern to light my way. Are you making fun of me?”
His friend said, “You’ve got it wrong. Other people are walking on the road too. If you carry a lantern, they’ll be able to see you and won’t bump into you.”
english_full:
Before electric lights existed, people used lanterns to light their way at night.

One day, a blind man visited a friend. After dark, his friend lit a lantern for him and said, “It’s late and the road is dark. Take this lantern home with you!”

The blind man said angrily, “You know I can’t see, yet you’re telling me to carry a lantern to light my way. Are you making fun of me?”

His friend said, “You’ve got it wrong. Other people are walking on the road too. If you carry a lantern, they’ll be able to see you and won’t bump into you.”
